text:
Ashley: Quick q — thinking about a canary for enterprise routes that overrides global weighted split. Can we do header-based pinning + weighted fallback? Example: X-Org-Canary: beta -> 100% to v2, else 5% global. Thoughts?

Kai: Order is everything. Header match must be evaluated before the random-sample splitter. Otherwise the sample eats the traffic before header pinning runs. Also watch session stickiness; we should use consistent-hash on a stable user id.

Jorge: Agree. Also add a guardrail that header-override can't exceed 20% of total traffic accidentally. Seen customers misconfigure and route 100% via header when proxies rewrite headers.

Emma: +1. We should auto-normalize headers (lowercase) and reject if the header value pattern is unknown. Ops can opt into an "allowlist" of org ids for header canaries.

Felix: Here's a draft policy snippet we used in staging:
```yaml
- route: /v1/generate
  match:
    headers:
      X-Org-Canary: beta
  action:
    target: model-v2
    override: true
- route: /v1/generate
  match:
    random_sample: 0.05
  action:
    weighted:
      model-v1: 0.95
      model-v2: 0.05
  tags: [global-canary]
```
If header match runs first, header traffic goes to v2, rest goes through sample.

Kai: Telemetry: tag every span with `routing.variant` and `routing.seed` so we can slice evals. Add an event when header-override triggers and include org id hash bucket (but keep PII out).

Ashley: Good point about PII. Use hashed(org_id) and only store bucket-level metrics. Also we need dashboard panels:
- header-override qps
- percent of orgs triggering override
- error rate vs baseline for header vs sample

infra-bot: deploy-bot applied canary policy to staging at 1837123500 :rocket:

deploy-bot: noticed mismatch — header normalization disabled on one ingress instance, rolling restart scheduled.

Emma: UX: in the Console rollout page we should show a stacked view: confirmed header routes (by org), sampled traffic, and fallback. And allow a "pause header" button.

Jorge: Edge case: what if header pins to v2 but v2 is incompatible (schema mismatch)? Add automatic schema check and fail open to fallback model with alert.

Ashley: Agreed. Action items:
- Kai: add header-first evaluation to router (PR)
- Felix: update staging policy and add normalization check
- Emma: mock Console wireframe for stacked canary view
- Jorge: schema probe + fail-open logic

Ashley: Thanks all — next sync Wed. :thumbsup:
